body:
Add ability to set workflow run/execution timeout when resetting a running / completed execution.
This would either override the currently set one(s) or set them if none were defined.

comments.body:
Workflow reset would extend workflow timeout with a full timeout starting from NOW. 
Is that not working?  Is the intention for new workflow to use a different timeout than the original one? What is the use case? Would it make more sense to extend UpdateWorkflowExecutionOptions API to be able to update workflow timeouts?

title: Workflow reset: add ability to set workflow run/execution timeout
